limits: No acceptance tolerance: every differing pixel is recorded; exact equality is reported separately.

Both frozen attempts and served buffers have identical world/terrain hashes; exact integration/source preflight isolates only the reviewed shade delta. A raw native planting source change is recorded separately when its actual narrow adapter bytes are identical.

Isolated corridor art/plants and real shared lights, exact extracted live fog hook plus horizonFog and shadowFrame helpers. Sky/hemi/sun energy remains the same probe ambience, not a complete live world.

Color mode retains original audit sun/hemisphere settings. Shadow mode uses exact runtime walk shadowFrame, full2048/lite1024 resolution, requested PCFSoftShadowMap (effective renderer type recorded), near1, normalBias.05 and bias-.00006; point lights remain shadowless.

Shadow readback is the RGBA color attachment, with material-dependent Basic/RGBA depth encoding. The actual depthTexture consumed by the shadow shader is not read or compared; no depth precision or world-distance equality is claimed.
Shadow silhouette comparison has no extra receiver plane and does not replace final in-world theme/device captures.

With --sequential the same renderer, camera, art meshes/materials and lights survive every ordered pose within a theme/tier/time/mode/wind case. Planting is deliberately recreated per pose by existing api.begin for deterministic born=-1e9, so this is not plant-streaming acceptance. Browser visual performance/Date clocks and CARD_CLOCK are fixed.

CPU render-submit duration uses a saved original bound performance.now captured before the visual clock override. It is real CPU/WebGL submission wall time, not GPU timer/query time. First render may include shader compilation; cpu-repeats retains separate warmed submissions without adding/omitting render objects.
